entries.what: Morning run on the Delgado Park loop, then school. After dinner and dishes, she goes through the summer engineering program form at the old desktop and sends it to the assistant to check for typos for the third time.
entries.outcome: Finds nothing real, still doesn't submit.

entries.what: Robotics isn't on Mondays, so she studies at the library homework center after school and tallies bird photos in her notebook.
Does the dishes and checks that Lola Cora ate her lunch, since Ramón is on a shift day.
Veterans Day, school closed. She sleeps in, then walks to Delgado Park for the bandstand ceremony crowd and a loop with Nadia.
entries.outcome: Easy day, talks about the count.

entries.what: Back home, she works on AP Lang reading and calls the Mom sheet numbers into a rough table.
Dinner with Grace, Ramón and Lola Cora; Grace asks about the summer form and Isabel deflects with sarcasm.
Mateo math at the Wednesday tutoring session, 4-5, using ratio problems.
entries.outcome: Mateo gets three in a row right.

entries.what: That evening Nadia comes over and sits with her at the desktop until Isabel finally hits submit on the summer engineering institute application.
entries.outcome: Application submitted, ahead of the Nov 15 due date.

entries.what: She and Nadia split boba-free tea and snacks in the kitchen to celebrate.
First fall storm; the Delgado Park loop is flooded so she skips her run, and starts jumping rope in the garage instead.
Walks to school in the rain, then robotics Thursday 3:30-6 in room C7 as mechanical lead, working on the drivetrain.
Grace picks her up from robotics through the flooded Vinca streets; they ride in near silence.
Rain continues; classes go on and she checks news about Ulloa Salt Marsh Park trail flooding between periods.
Late afternoon she asks the assistant whether the boardwalk flooding damages marsh habitat and whether the count will still happen.
entries.outcome: Learns the count is likely to go ahead if the water drops.

entries.what: Sets out boots and binoculars for the count and goes to bed after midnight.
At 7 a.m. she joins the volunteer group at the boardwalk trailhead for the egret count at Ulloa, using her repaired phone for photos.
entries.outcome: Count happens with a muddy trail and a good egret tally.

entries.what: After the count she skips SAT prep and instead has lunch at home with Lola Cora.
entries.outcome: Shows Lola Cora the bird photos.

entries.what: Evening she finishes the Mom sheet design and is home by her 9 p.m. curfew—actually 10 since it was renegotiated.
Sunday sinigang with Lola Cora after Mass; Grace grades at the table.
She asks the assistant for out-of-state net-price numbers for a one-page sheet formatted like Grace's grading rubrics.
She presents the sheet to Grace at the kitchen table, with Ramón present.
entries.outcome: Grace reads it closely and agrees to talk numbers.
